svg.title: Mobile — player, library and queue
svg.desc: Touch-first 44 px targets, readable hierarchy and explicit queue semantics. Conceptual mobile layouts; native safe areas and gestures require platform implementation.
svg.text: 390 × 844 logical px · touch-first targets · safe-area insets are host responsibilities
